quote: Elevator in my building goes to 14. Building has 12 floors. Pressed 14 once. Doors opened to a hallway with carpeting from the 1970s and a smell like my grandmother's apartment. I didn't step out. The doors closed. The button was gone the next morning.
context: Architectural impossibilities in the GLMZ are transient. They appear, offer themselves, and vanish if declined. No one has documented what happens to those who accept.
